text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The Mile Championship is right around the corner! King is planning to run too, but lately she's been on a losing streak…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: She challenges me to a scrimmage, even though she's already tired after running in a race today. I end up winning pretty soundly, but King's not ready to give up!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: She shows me that her charm is rooted in her unflagging tenacity! Realizing that, I see that there was never any reason for me to worry about her!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: In fact, she's a goddess in the flesh! I'm gonna do my best in the Mile Championship so I can do her proud!
